nodes.description: Ownable.owner: privileged address that gates onlyOwner functions
HeapTycoon.master: address receiving MASTER_FEE and create() deposits
HeapTycoon.heaps: dynamic array of Heap structs holding game state and player lists
HeapTycoon.used_names: mapping preventing duplicate heap names
PAGE_SIZE constant used for pagination of get_heaps
MASTER_FEE constant paid to master on every buy
MIN_TICKET lower bound for heap ticket price
MAX_TICKET upper bound for heap ticket price
HeapTycoon constructor(address addr): sets master and reserves the empty name
set_master(address addr): onlyOwner update of the master address
create(...): payable heap creation with ticket/fee/timer/bonus validation and master payout
buy(uint256 id): payable participation that pays master, a pseudo-random player, bonus holder and heap owner
get_len(): view returning number of heaps
get_heaps(uint256 page): paginated view of heaps with remaining timers
is_name_used(bytes32 name): view of used_names mapping
get_heap(uint256 id): view returning detailed heap data and remaining timer
Ownable constructor(): sets owner to msg.sender
renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner, clears owner to address(0)
transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner wrapper delegating to _transferOwnership
_transferOwnership(address): internal owner reassignment
SafeMath.mul(uint256,uint256): checked multiplication
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256): integer division
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256): checked subtraction
SafeMath.add(uint256,uint256): checked addition
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, authorization, player lists and payouts
tx.origin: transaction origin used in create() and buy() as an anti-contract authorization check
block.timestamp (now): drives heap timers, bonus eligibility and view countdowns
master.transfer(msg.value) in create(): external value transfer
master.send(MASTER_FEE) in buy(): external value transfer
heaps[id].players[index].send(val) in buy(): external value transfer to pseudo-randomly chosen player
heaps[id].cur_addr.send(bonus_val) in buy(): external value transfer of accumulated bonus
heaps[id].owner.send(heaps[id].fee) in buy(): external value transfer of heap fee
keccak256 of blockhash(block.number - i) used to derive payout index: miner-influenceable weak randomness
create() parameter ticket: heap ticket price bounds-checked against MIN/MAX_TICKET
create() parameter name: unique heap name stored in used_names
create() parameter fee: owner fee paid on each buy
create() parameter timer_inc: seconds added to the heap timer on each buy
create() parameter bonus_fee: per-buy increment of the bonus pool
buy() parameter id: index of the targeted heap

transferOwnership() parameter _newOwner: new owner address
_transferOwnership() parameter _newOwner: new owner address
